title: ParsedBlock
description: A single typographic block emitted by a Parser (see docs/contracts/parser-interface.md). The chunking service consumes these to detect headings and assemble Chunks per docs/contracts/chunking-contract.md.

text.description: The block's text content. Whitespace-only blocks must be omitted, not emitted with empty or whitespace text.

blockType.description: Best-effort classification. 'other' is the catch-all for content the parser cannot confidently classify (page numbers, running headers, decorative elements).

fontSize.description: Font size in PDF points. Required when parser.supports_typography is True; null permitted only on the OCR path (TesseractParser).

bold.description: True when the parser confidently identifies the block as bold. False is the safe default for parsers that cannot detect weight (OCR path).

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points. Null permitted only on the OCR path.

pageNum.description: 1-indexed PDF page number. Must match the enclosing ParsedPage.page_num.
